mentions.name: Uxwizz
mentions.description: This web analytics tool provides session replays and heatmaps that show how visitors actually use a landing page — where people get stuck, what grabs attention, and what message gets across — helping teams figure out product-market fit before building too much.
mentions.problem: Seeing how people actually use a landing page, not just whether they click.
mentions.audience: Product builders and founders using the tool to figure out product-market fit on landing pages.
mentions.source_excerpt:
One thing that can help a lot early on is seeing how people actually use the landing page, not just if they click. Stuff like session replays or heatmaps can show where people get stuck[0], what grabs attention, and what’s actually getting across your message. It’s surprisingly useful for figuring out product-market fit before building too much.

[0] https://uxwizz.com
